results.title: Metaplanet CEO shuts down Bitcoin sale speculation after $322M transfer
results.summary: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich said no Bitcoin was sold after the company moved 5,014 BTC between custodial addresses for about $8 in fees.

results.title: Morgan Stanley's infrastructure partner Zerohash rebuffed in pitch to be U.S. trust bank
results.summary: Zerohash, which handles crypto plumbing for Morgan Stanley's E*Trade, said it's planning on re-filing and hoping for a swift resolution.

results.title: Solana neared a freeze threshold Wednesday, Marinade Finance says. The Foundation says it held up under stress.
results.summary: A routing glitch at a major data center provider knocked nearly 29% of Solana’s staked tokens offline, bringing the network within striking distance of a full freeze, while Foundation executives stressed that blocks and transactions never stopped.
